about_the_game:
The Dragon Vein withers, civilization hangs by a thread! As the last hope of the dragonkin, gather legendary allies in a fast-paced action TD fused with deep roguelite progression! Customize hundreds of trap and character abilities, dash through multi-level battlefields to set deadly killzones, and unleash synergistic combos in 4-player co-op! Every run is a fresh strategic challenge – fight for your species' survival!

1. Epic Redemption on the Brink of Extinction

Dragons once maintained cosmic balance through the Dragon Vein – until demons incited a war of annihilation. Facing extinction, young azure dragon Cynton embarks on a desperate quest.

He awakens the ancient dragon Stars, allies with time-walker Qingyu, wolf prince Miu, arctic warrior Whorf, phoenix sovereign Icarus, and even Minnyel from the underworld. Though they shatter the demonic plot, they discover the war has drained the Dragon Vein – the dragons are fading!

In their darkest hour, Icarus guides Cynton beyond the skies. Within an orbital station, the mechanical lifeform Ron unveils civilization’s final hope…

2. Core Gameplay: Dynamic Builds × Tactical TD × Roguelite Evolution

● [Multi-dimensional Battlefield Commander]

Dominate intricate multi-tiered maps! Sprint, snipe, cast skills, and deploy chained trap systems. Manipulate flip gates, energy geysers, and environmental hazards to funnel foes into deathtraps!

● [Deep Roguelite Progression]

Every run = A new evolution path! Spend skill points earned mid-battle to unlock:

○ Trap Mastery: Unlock 6 unique upgrades per trap (e.g., frost turret → chain-freeze/area burst/damage splash).

○ Character Ascension: Access 90+ upgrades per hero (enhance skills, unlock passives, alter attack patterns) to forge your playstyle!

● [4-Player Co-op Symphony]

Team up to combine hero skills and traps for devastating synergies!

3. Signature Experience

● ★ Full Furry Fantasy Battalion

Command charismatic beastkin heroes – each with 1 basic attack, 1 passive talent & 3 active skills for distinct gameplay.

● ★ Limitless Builds × Infinite Replayability

○ EA: 540+ character abilities (6 heroes × 90+ upgrades)

○ 120+ trap evolutions (20 base traps × 6 paths)

Full Release: 12 heroes & 35 traps – depth rivaling strategy classics!

● ★ VTuber Special Ops

Popular Virtual Idols join as exclusive furry fighters with unique skills!

● ★ Anime Fantasy Aesthetics

Vibrant anime visuals span dragon temples to cosmic stations.

4. EA Content & Roadmap

Early Access Core:

● 6 Heroes: Cynton, Stars, Qingyu, Miu, Whorf, Icarus

● 20 Base Traps + 6 upgrades each

● 3 Themed Worlds (Dragon Palace/Ancient Forest/​​Frozen Caldera​) × 9 Maps

● 3 Difficulties (Normal/Hard/Nightmare) + 3 Boss Arenas

● 10 Elite Foes + 22 Mechanic-driven Minions

Full Release Vision (In Development):

● ▲ 10 Total Heroes → Unlock station allies & secret champions!

● ▲ 35 Advanced Traps → Revolutionary build diversity!

● ▲ 6 Expansive Worlds → New Desert Ruins & Cosmic Hub (19 maps, incl. Final Boss Arena!)

● ▲ 7 Epic Bosses → Colossal threats await at each world’s climax!

● ▲ 1024 Achievements → 982 Standard / 40 Brutal / 2 Hidden

Fight for Civilization, Evolve for Survival!

Furry Defenders fuses together the depth of tactical tower defense, the thrill of action combat, the freedom of roguelite builds, and the chaos of multiplayer co-op! Whether you're a lone wolf or a squad leader, forge your path to survival across a fantasy continent on the brink of oblivion.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 或 AMD 同等配置
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 750ti
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 或 AMD 同等配置
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 或 AMD RX 580, 4GB VRam 或 Intel Arc A380
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: In Furry Defenders, where the Demon Clan covets the Dragon Veins and incites war among all races, you will play as Cynton, the Dragon Bloodline Warrior. Rally your allies and set masterful traps at crucial passes to outsmart the looming threat of the Demon Army.
